prompt_text: What are the best vacation rentals in Santa Cruz County California and how do I pick one?
answer_verbatim:
# Finding Vacation Rentals in Santa Cruz County

## Popular Platforms
- **Airbnb** - Largest selection, user reviews
- **VRBO** - Specializes in full homes
- **Booking.com** - Good filters and deals
- **Local sites** - Santa Cruz tourism board website

## Top Areas to Consider
- **Santa Cruz Beach Boardwalk** - Classic, touristy, walkable
- **Capitola** - Charming village, colorful houses, quieter
- **Aptos** - Beach access, more residential
- **Watsonville** - Inland, agricultural area, budget-friendly
- **Scotts Valley** - Mountain setting, near redwoods

## How to Pick One

**Define your priorities:**
- Budget range
- Beach access vs. other activities
- Group size and layout needs
- Pet-friendly?
- Parking situation

**Check reviews carefully:**
- Read recent reviews (last 3-6 months)
- Look for comments on cleanliness, accuracy, host responsiveness
- Watch for repeated complaints

**Verify details:**
- Confirm exact location on map
- Check what's actually included (parking, WiFi, kitchen)
- Understand cancellation policy
- Clarify any fees (cleaning, service, etc.)

**Ask questions:**
- Contact hosts before booking about your specific needs
- Responsive hosts are usually good signs

**Consider timing:**
- Summer is peak season (pricier, crowded)
- Fall/winter offers better deals and fewer tourists

What type of experience are you looking for?
